_about: IonQ 공식 로드맵 마일스톤 정답표 (연구계획 §1.3 / 정렬 절차 §4). 숫자가 아니라 역량 단위. version=2020 은 2020-12-09 블로그(코퍼스 내) + 당시 로드맵 차트(이미지, 2차 보도 기준; confidence=reported), version=2025 는 2025-06-13 가속 로드맵 블로그와 2025-10-13 #AQ 64 글(cutoff 이후, data/ground_truth/src_*.md). 생성 로드맵 정렬은 layer 무관하게 의미로 한다.

milestones.label: Algorithmic Qubits (#AQ) adopted as the roadmap metric
milestones.description: IonQ defines #AQ (effectively perfect qubits usable for a typical program) and bases its roadmap on it instead of Quantum Volume or physical qubit counts.

milestones.label: 32-qubit system with 22 #AQ
milestones.description: The next system (32 physical qubits) is expected to feature 22 algorithmic qubits; first of three new systems in development.

milestones.label: Gate quality improvement to raise #AQ
milestones.description: For the next few years IonQ focuses on improving quantum logic gate quality to increase usable (algorithmic) qubits.

milestones.label: Low-overhead quantum error correction, then scale physical qubits
milestones.description: After gate-quality gains, implement low-overhead QEC (13:1 overhead demonstrated) and scale physical qubit count to boost #AQ substantially.

milestones.label: Modular quantum computers networked in a datacenter
milestones.description: By 2023, deploy modular quantum computers small enough to be networked together in a datacenter (photonic interconnect).

milestones.label: Broad quantum advantage by 2025
milestones.description: IonQ expects to achieve broad quantum advantage by 2025.

milestones.label: #AQ 35 performance target (2024)
milestones.description: Roadmap chart target #AQ 35 for 2024; achieved on Forte in early 2024 per IonQ blog.

milestones.label: #AQ 64 performance target (2025)
milestones.description: Roadmap chart target #AQ 64 for 2025 (fulfilled on Tempo in October 2025, ahead of schedule).

milestones.label: #AQ 256 (2026) / #AQ 384 (2027) / #AQ 1024 (2028) chart targets
milestones.description: Later-year #AQ targets from the 2020 roadmap chart as reported in secondary sources (image, not in blog text).

milestones.label: Tempo development systems with 100 physical qubits
milestones.description: 2025: development systems supporting 100 physical qubits for Tempo; #AQ 64 achieved on a Tempo development system in October 2025.

milestones.label: 10,000 physical qubits on a single chip
milestones.description: 2027: a single chip holding 10,000 physical qubits, enabled by 2D ion-trap technology.

milestones.label: Two interconnected chips, 20,000 physical qubits, networking online
milestones.description: 2028: two interconnected chips for 20,000 physical qubits in one system; commercially available interconnected (clustered) system.

milestones.label: 2,000,000 physical qubits; 40,000–80,000 logical qubits
milestones.description: By 2030: a system with over two million physical qubits translating to 40k–80k logical qubits.

milestones.label: Logical error rate below 1e-12 with latest QEC codes
milestones.description: By 2030 logical qubits achieve logical error rates <1E-12 for shallow memory schemes; design allows future QEC code updates.

milestones.label: 2D ion-trap chips with ~300x trap density (Oxford Ionics)
milestones.description: Oxford Ionics' 2D trap technology (electronic control) offers up to 300x higher trap density than projected 1D systems, raising physical qubits per chip.

milestones.label: Quantum-memory photonic interconnects (Lightsynq), up to 50x entanglement rate
milestones.description: Memory-based photonic interconnects enable asynchronous entanglement, ~50x ion-ion entanglement rate; clustered computing commercially ready by 2028.

milestones.label: Metric shift from #AQ to physical qubits, 2Q fidelity, logical qubits, logical error rate
milestones.description: After #AQ 64, IonQ retires #AQ as the primary roadmap measure in favor of physical qubit count, median two-qubit fidelity, logical qubit count and logical error rates.

milestones.label: Acquisitions as scaling mechanism (Lightsynq, Oxford Ionics)
milestones.description: Strategic acquisitions (Lightsynq 2025, Oxford Ionics 2025) supply interconnect memory and 2D trap/electronic-control capability to accelerate the roadmap.

milestones.label: Quantum-accelerated drug-development workflow (AstraZeneca, AWS, NVIDIA) 20x speedup
milestones.description: Hybrid quantum-classical chemistry workflow (Suzuki-Miyaura step) with >20x time-to-solution speedup; pharma as lead application.
